method: Description-based synthetic voice design; no actor recordings or cloned actor voices.

voices.description: Adult American male, medium-low pitch, rounded nasal placement, broad slightly dopey vowels, soft husky edge, relaxed rising-and-falling comic rhythm, friendly but easily confused. Not a polished announcer.
voices.referenceText: Hello, I am calling about a problem with my account. Can you explain what happened?

voices.description: Mature American woman, low alto pitch with pronounced dry gravelly vocal fry and a gently pinched nasal resonance. Patient, concerned, practical delivery, slow to medium pace; warm restrained emotion, never airy or youthful.
